[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]

  • Hyphenation: ba‧la‧i

Noun

[edit]

balai

  1. godmother

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Malay balai (polis) (“police station”),

Pronunciation

[edit]

  • Southern Min
    • (Hokkien: Penang)
      • Pe̍h-ōe-jī: bâ-lái
      • Tâi-lô: bâ-lái
      • Phofsit Daibuun: balae
      • Sinological IPA (Penang): /ba²³⁻²¹ lai⁴⁴⁵/

Noun

[edit]

balai

  1. (Malaysia) police station

Esperanto

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

A verbal formation from French balai, from Gaulish balatno and Gaulish banatlo.[1]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /baˈlai/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ai
  • Syllabification: ba‧la‧i

Verb

[edit]

balai (present balaas, past balais, future balaos, conditional balaus, volitive balau)

  1. to sweep

French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Old French balai, from earlier balain (“bundle of broom”, 12th c.), ultimately from Proto-Celtic *banatlo- (“broom plant”). It is uncertain whether the Celtic word passed into French through a Gaulish *balano- or rather through Middle Breton balain, balazn, from Old Breton balan. The latter appears more likely.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ba.lɛ/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (France (Saint-Maurice-de-Beynost)):(file)
  • Audio (Canada (Shawinigan)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Toulouse)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Agen)):(file)
  • Homophones: balais, ballet, ballets

Noun

[edit]

balai m (plural balais)

  1. broom
  2. broomstick flown by witches
  3. (colloquial) the last bus or train (at night)
  4. tail (of a bird of prey)
  5. brush (electrical contact)
  6. blade (of windscreen wiper)
  7. (slang) year (used in referring to someone’s age)
    Elle a quarante balais ― She’s forty
    • 2006, Virginie Despentes, “Coucher avec l'ennemi”, in King Kong Théorie [King Kong Theory], Éditions Grasset, →ISBN, page 61:
      Je regardais les femmes plus vieilles que moi, toute une vie à bosser comme ça, pour gagner des SMIC à peine améliorés et à cinquante balais se faire engueuler par le chef de rayon parce qu'on sort trop souvent pisser.
      (please add an English translation of this quotation)

Derived terms

[edit]
  • avoir un balai dans le cul
  • con comme un balai
  • donner un coup de balai
  • du balai
  • fou comme un balai
  • manche à balai
  • voiture-balai

Descendants

[edit]
  • Haitian Creole: bale
  • → Esperanto: balai

Further reading

[edit]
  • “balai”, in Trésor de la langue française informatisé [Digitized Treasury of the French Language], 2012

Indonesian

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

Inherited from Malay balai, from Proto-Malayic *balay, from Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *balay, from Proto-Austronesian *balay. Semantic loan from Minangkabau balai for sense of market.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Indonesian) IPA(key): /ˈbalai̯/ [ˈba.lai̯]
  • Rhymes: -alai̯
  • Syllabification: ba‧lai

Noun

[edit]

balai (plural balai-balai)

  1. public hall, balei
    Synonym: paseban
  2. building
    Synonym: gedung
  3. office or bureau
    Synonyms: biro, kantor
  4. house of parliament
  5. (dated) house in a palace
  6. market
    Synonyms: pasar, pekan
Related terms
[edit]
  • balairung

Malay

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Proto-Malayic *balay, from Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *balay, from Proto-Austronesian *balay. Compare with Māori whare and Hawaiian hale.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈbalaj/ [ˈba.lai̯]
  • Audio (Malaysia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -alai̯, -lai̯, -ai̯
  • Hyphenation: ba‧lai

Noun

[edit]

balai (Jawi spelling بالاي, plural balai-balai or balai2)

  1. hall, station, large building for public uses, balei[1]
  2. (possibly obsolete) house
    Synonym: rumah
  3. (dialectal) veranda, a front part of traditional house
  4. (Malaysia, colloquial) clipping of balai polis (“police station”)

Derived terms

[edit]
  • balai polis
  • balai raya
  • balairong seri

Descendants

[edit]
  • > Indonesian: balai (inherited)
  • → Hokkien: 峇厘 (bâ-lî), balai
  • → Teochew: 峇厘 (bha7 li5)

References

[edit]
  1. ^ “balai”, in Kamus Dewan [The Institute Dictionary] (in Malay), Fourth edition, Kuala Lumpur: Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka, 2005, →ISBN

Further reading

[edit]
  • "balai" in Pusat Rujukan Persuratan Melayu (PRPM) [Malay Literary Reference Centre (PRPM)] (in Malay), Kuala Lumpur: Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka, 2017
